project.title: Original production plan from authorized video evidence
project.creative_brief: Create an original 6-second 16:9 brand intro for an invented paper-craft studio (PAPERFIELD, tagline 'one fold, one flight.'), using a staggered text reveal over one slow-pushing luminous object — new subject, new brand, new copy; do not reproduce the reference's blob, wordmark, or taglines.
global_negative_constraints: No source footage, copied frames, exact composition, original dialogue, music, or source-specific visual expression
No recognizable people, voices, copyrighted characters, third-party logos, trademarks, packaging, or pseudo-text unless independently authorized

analysis_coverage.vision_model: none — Ollama not installed on this VM; per-frame analysis is human visual review of the 6 extracted frames
analysis_coverage.vision_model_note: qwen2.5vl:7b was NOT run: no ollama binary; 1.1 GB RAM free at run time, insufficient for a 7B VLM. Coverage is 'partial' for this reason even though all 6 sampled frames were reviewed.

beats.observable_evidence: Scene: Near-black frame; one iridescent liquid-metal blob, centre-right, about 55% of frame width; text only as a faint ghost.; subjects: iridescent liquid-metal blob; action: Very slow push-in begins; wordmark and pill text are fading in from black.; composition: Blob right of centre against large empty black space on the left; faint dust specks top-left..
beats.reusable_mechanism: Cold open on a single luminous object in darkness; text enters only after the object is established.
beats.original_adaptation: Cold open on the paper crane alone in near-darkness; no wordmark yet, only the crane's vermilion wing-tip catching first light.

prompt.scene: Near-black desk scene at dawn; a single hand-folded paper crane, cream paper with one vermilion wing-tip, resting on a dawn-lit wooden desk, no text on screen.
prompt.visual: Low-key, near-black background; one warm highlight on the crane's wing-tip; large empty space left of frame.
prompt.action: Camera holds, then begins a very slow push-in; the crane does not move.
prompt.camera: Static 16:9 frame, slow push-in, eye-level, centred right of frame.
prompt.sound: Silence, or a single soft paper-rustle cue at the end of the beat (new sound, not from the reference).
prompt.continuity: Crane position, desk grain and light direction are locked for all later beats.
negative_constraints: No text, no logo, no wordmark in this beat
No second object, no person, no camera shake
Replace or exclude: MOSEN wordmark
Replace or exclude: AI 影像工作室
Replace or exclude: one person, one forest.

beats.observable_evidence: Scene: Text block entering left: pill badge legible, large white wordmark legible; tagline lines not yet visible.; subjects: iridescent liquid-metal blob, text block (pill badge + wordmark); action: Pill badge and wordmark fade/slide in; blob continues its slow push-in and grows slightly.; composition: Text block left third; blob right half; the final letter of the wordmark overlaps the blob's bright left rim..
beats.reusable_mechanism: First text layer arrives after the object: a small pill badge, then the large wordmark.
beats.original_adaptation: First text layer arrives after the crane: a small pill badge reading 'PAPER CRAFT STUDIO', then the wordmark PAPERFIELD.
